results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: FY27 revenue growth guidance is now about 30% on FY26's ₹1,339 Cr, which is about ₹1,740 Cr. H1 was ₹767 Cr, so H2 needs about ₹973 Cr; split by last year's pattern that is about ₹470 Cr in Q3 and ₹503 Cr in Q4.
EBITDA margin guidance is 38-40% for FY27. H1 was 37.7%, so H2 needs about 40%; Q2 was 40.3%.
New CDMO contracts start contributing in H2, and the ₹1,000 Cr CDMO target for FY27 depends on it. Specialty chemicals should stay near the H1 level.
risks: CDMO deliveries are lumpy; a delay moves revenue into Q4
